scientific_integrity: Constructive exact proof and attached reproducibility certificates; no claim of independent audit, novelty priority certification or minimality.
scientific_limitations: Only two unordered collision-free points on standard topological complete bipartite graphs with at least two vertices in each part.
Only the quotient by the full graph automorphism group, not proper subgroups or Borel equivariant homotopy.
The orbit space is generally noncompact; the asserted compact disk is a strong deformation retract and not the original space up to homeomorphism.
Explicit triangulations are certified, not proved vertex-minimal.
Exact finite certificates and the equality-pattern universality argument have self-review; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
An equivalent unindexed earlier result is a residual publication-priority risk.
title: Disk retractions for two-particle symmetry quotients of complete bipartite graphs
